rules.title: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

onExit.title: Confirm with HMRC that Making Tax Digital no longer applies (after three years below the threshold)

penalty.text: Penalty points; £200 at the threshold

rules.note: From 6 April 2026. Threshold falls to 30,000 (April 2027) and 20,000 (April 2028). Checked against GOV.UK on 31 Oct 2026: qualifying income above £50,000 in 2024-25 means start 6 April 2026; above £30,000 in 2025-26 means 6 April 2027; above £20,000 in 2026-27 means 6 April 2028. HMRC tests the Self Assessment return for the tax year two years before the start. GOV.UK does not state the exit rule.
